what_this_shows: The OCR output keeps almost every token of the source but destroys the list ordering: items (a) and (b) are merged, and the content of (a) is emitted afterwards as display math. A text-only metric that ignores order scores this highly; the rendered image makes the error obvious. Behaves as you would hope: the faithful transcription scores high, the reordered one is rejected.
observed_note: Measured once on the reference setup. Scores are not bitwise reproducible, so expect small differences; large ones mean something in your setup differs.
